content.short: Ondo Finance is a leading RWA protocol that tokenizes institutional-grade assets like US Treasuries for DeFi users.
content.description: Ondo Finance is the definitive protocol for tokenized real-world assets (RWAs), designed to bridge the gap between institutional finance and decentralized protocols. The platform offers a suite of regulated, blockchain-enabled investment products, including OUSG (Tokenized US Treasuries) and USDY (a yield-bearing stablecoin alternative). By providing on-chain access to high-quality, short-term US government debt, Ondo enables investors to earn institutional-grade yields in a transparent environment. As a market leader in the RWA space, Ondo Finance manages billions in TVL across major networks like Ethereum and Solana.
